items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: we used to entertain Roger Wolfe Kahn, Paul Whiteman, Henry Bussv... It was a small nightclub called The Nest... We played the Nest

ctx.x: Oh, 133rd right off of Seventh Avenue. Incidentally, we used to entertain Roger Wolfe Kahn, Paul Whiteman, Henry Bussv, and all the royalty of Europe used to come there because they also had a review. It was a small nightclub called The Nest, and again, we had what they called then symphonic jazz band. We played the Nest, I guess a year or year and a half or so and the people heard us at Club Alabam.
Fletcher was leaving the Club Alabam.
